policy.description: All unrestricted public EKODI sites, sub-sites, posts, events, products and services are projected automatically from canonical publication registries and the runtime Public Registry. No per-route discovery registration is required. Admin, auth, API, personal/private, preview and preparing surfaces are excluded by default.
